entries.t: 中国投运全球首台16 MW TLP漂浮式海上风电机组
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能源测/发电技术/风电
entries.as: 中国投运全球首台16兆瓦张力腿（TLP）漂浮式海上风电机组，标志深远海风电迈向工业化。该机组采用TLP平台设计，抗台风、低造价、深水适应性强，单机容量领先全球。然而颇具反讽意味的是，其首批绿电将用于海上油气平台的供电，以清洁能源支撑化石能源开采。这一部署既展现了中国的深远海风电工程实力，也揭示了能源转型中的过渡性现实。项目对全球漂浮式风电标准化、规模化具有示范意义。
kp: [单机容量[TLP漂浮式海上风电]]: 16 MW
entries.b:
In a striking twist of ecological irony, China is deploying a massive piece of green technology to power the extraction of fossil fuels. Reports suggest that the world’s first 16-megawatt tension-leg platform (TLP) floating offshore wind turbine has set sail.
Developed by the China National Offshore Oil Corporation (CNOOC), the colossal structure departed its assembly site in Zhuhai on Sunday, June 28.
reported that its destination is the Lufeng oilfield cluster, which is located deep in the moody waters of the South China Sea.
Rather than feeding an onshore grid, this turbine has a highly specific job. It will beam electricity directly to offshore drilling platforms via heavy-duty subsea cables, creating a green engine for extracting oil and gas.
With the merging of offshore wind power with oil and gas operations, this project aims to drive down the carbon emissions generated by daily offshore oilfield activities.
tension-leg platform
(TLP) is a buoyant, floating structure moored to the seafloor by taut, vertical steel cables. These high-tension cables virtually eliminate vertical movement, providing exceptional stability even in deep and turbulent ocean waters.
This colossal structure is about 307 meters tall and weighs up to 8,000 tonnes. By single-turbine
, it is the largest floating platform of its exact kind ever built.
The platform would achieve stability in deep, turbulent waters through taut mooring lines that secure its floating foundation firmly to the seabed.

Once fully operational, the project will serve as a high-stakes proof of concept for the marine economy. It is expected to generate an average of 54 million kilowatt-hours of electricity annually. That is enough to slash carbon dioxide emissions by roughly 35,000 tonnes per year. Furthermore, the clean juice will save about 15,000 cubic meters of fuel oil that would otherwise be burned to keep the Lufeng pumps spinning.
This calculated paradox integrates renewable wind energy directly into typical fossil fuel operations, allowing CNOOC to cut the heavy carbon footprint inherent to offshore extraction.
Regional officials are watching closely. The project aligns perfectly with a broader push to cultivate a cleaner, more efficient energy system across the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area.
Beyond its immediate environmental benefits, the project is expected to supercharge the broader marine economy by fostering local supply chains and advanced maritime engineering.
This latest milestone highlights deep-sea offshore
as a vital strategic frontier for China’s global energy leadership and for driving the commercialization of clean technology.
This progress is highlighted by recent infrastructure developments. One being the June 2026 installation of the world’s largest
offshore converter station
, “Heart of Sea Wind,” in Guangdong. It converts turbine-generated power into high-voltage direct current for grid transmission.
Global Times
reported that
’s offshore wind capacity accounted for a massive 78 percent of all newly grid-connected offshore wind capacity worldwide in 2025. According to official data, the nation’s total installed power generation capacity grew 11 percent year-on-year to 4.01 billion kilowatts by the end of May, propelled by a 17 percent surge in installed wind power capacity alone, which now stands at 660 million kilowatts.

entries.t: Realta Fusion称其在高温超导轴对称磁镜聚变装置上实现等离子体动能直接转化为电能
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能源测/发电技术/核电
entries.as: 美国聚变公司Realta Fusion在WHAM高温超导磁镜装置上实现直接能量转换（DEC），绕过传统热循环将等离子体动能直接转为电能，约100V下输出数安培电流点亮灯泡。首席科学官明确强调这只是概念验证，非净发电演示。公司规划2030年代中期建站，DEC预计贡献20%功率、效率超90%，可使度电成本降低10%—20%。
entries.b:
6月30日，美国聚变技术公司Realta Fusion在PRNewswire发布新闻稿称，其实现了高温超导轴对称磁镜聚变装置（Wisconsin HTS Axisymmetric Mirror，WHAM）的直接能量转换（Direct Energy Conversion，DEC），即绕过传统热循环，将等离子体动能直接转化为电能；能够在约100V电压下输出数安培电流，并提供足够电力点亮数个灯泡。文中称，其在WHAM装置末端安装了自主研发的原型电转换器，该转换器在装置一端使带电粒子减速，动能转化为电势能，建立电势或电压，并进一步驱动电流输出。
但其首席科学官Derek Sutherland也明确表示，这仍是首次概念验证，不是净发电演示，也不是将大规模聚变功率直接转化为电力的演示。Realta计划在2030年代中期开始建设第一代聚变电站，其规划80%的聚变功率来自传统热循环转化，剩余20%将通过直接能量转换（宣传效率超过90%）获得；该公司认为，DEC带来的效率提升可抵消其启动和维持聚变等离子体条件所注入的能量，并使每千瓦时成本降低10%—20%。

entries.t: 防止蒸馏第三方模型，Meta 限制 AI 工程师使用 Claude 与 Codex
entries.c: AI与智能科技/AI软件层/底座大模型/文本模型
entries.as: 据The Information报道，Meta内部文件显示已限制其AI工程部门工程师使用Anthropic的Claude Code与OpenAI的Codex。该决定与成本或生产力无关，主要目的是防止第三方模型通过代码交互被蒸馏，体现了大厂对AI核心竞争力的保护意识，也折射出AI行业日趋激烈的模型知识产权博弈。
entries.b:
6 月 29 日消息，据 The Information 报道，内部文件显示，Meta 已采取行动，限制其 AI 工程部门的工程师使用 Anthropic 的 Claude Code 与 OpenAI 的 Codex，不过该决定与成本或生产力无关。
IT之家获悉，这份 5 月出台、目前仍在生效的内部规范显示，
Meta 害怕无意间触发蒸馏行为
—— 也就是借助竞品模型的输出结果来训练自家 AI 模型，该操作涉嫌违反 Claude、Codex 的用户使用协议。
据悉，Meta 已要求相关团队暂停部分使用上述模型的任务，警告称若任由竞争对手的 AI 输出渗入 Meta 的训练数据，
可能会引发“与合作企业之间的严重纠纷与事态升级”
Meta 发言人表示：“我们有明确政策来规范团队如何使用 AI 工具，确保他们能够以负责任的方式专注于高影响力工作”。

entries.t: 智元人形机器人在为期六天的演示中验证工厂就绪能力
entries.c: AI与智能科技/具身智能/硬件和控制
entries.as: 中国机器人企业智元（AGIBOT）完成全球直播演示，其G2人形机器人在连续六天内自主执行质检、装配等工厂任务，验证了产品级量产就绪能力。此次演示展示了人形机器人在真实工业场景中的稳定性、自主决策与多机协同水平，标志着国产人形机器人从实验室走向规模化制造部署的关键一步，对制造业柔性自动化具有示范意义。
entries.b:
Chinese robotics player AGIBOT has completed a global livestream of G2 humanoid robots autonomously performing quality inspections and material handling.
Conducted at Longcheer Technology’s electronics manufacturing facility, the robots carried out tasks including tablet inspection, defect sorting, and material transport without interruption.
The milestone coincided with AGIBOT’s announcement that it has begun rolling out its 15,000th robot, highlighting the company’s rapid production growth.
In May, Figure AI
a 200-hour autonomous livestream with Figure 03 robots, processing nearly 250,000 packages without a single hardware failure.
AGIBOT has completed a six-day global
During the demonstration, the humanoid robots accumulated more than 64 hours of operation, completed 64,828 production-line tasks across more than four manufacturing workflows, achieved a reported task success rate of 99.99 percent, and contributed to the production of 17,625 tablet units. Unlike controlled laboratory demonstrations, the robots worked on an active mass-production line where they adapted to changing tasks and real-time factory operations.

AGIBOT claims the livestream was intended to demonstrate that humanoid robots can function reliably in practical industrial settings rather than staged environments. By broadcasting the operation continuously over six days, AGIBOT sought to provide transparent evidence of the robots’ ability to perform consistent, high-volume manufacturing work and support real-world production processes.
“By bringing multiple humanoid robots into a real production line and making the process visible over six consecutive days, we wanted to provide a more transparent answer to what embodied AI industrialization actually requires,” said Yao Maoqing, president of Embodied AI Business Unit at AGIBOT, in a
Coinciding with the six-day factory livestream, AGIBOT announced that its 15,000th robot has rolled off the production line and been delivered to manufacturing partner Longcheer, marking another milestone in the company’s manufacturing expansion.
The milestone robot is an AGIBOT G2, a wheeled mobile manipulator featuring a humanoid upper body designed for industrial applications such as material handling, inspection, and production-line support. According to the company, the achievement reflects a rapid increase in manufacturing capacity as demand for embodied AI systems continues to grow.
AGIBOT said its production scale has accelerated significantly over the past year. The company previously required about a year to increase cumulative production from 1,000 to 5,000 robots. Expanding output from 5,000 to 10,000 units took only three months, representing more than a fourfold increase in production speed compared with the previous phase. The company said it has maintained that momentum to reach the 15,000-unit milestone.
Experts suggest the latest production milestone underscores AGIBOT’s efforts to scale commercial deployment of its humanoid robots beyond pilot projects and into industrial manufacturing. Based on previously released industry figures, the company has also claimed the leading position in global
robot shipments, with a reported 39 percent share of the worldwide market.

entries.t: Nature Sensors｜细菌在培养皿里长了一夜，芯片闻出了它是谁
entries.c: 通用技术/检测和表征/先进科学仪器
entries.as: 据Nature Sensors报道，研究人员开发了一种基于芯片的气体传感技术，能够在细菌于培养皿中培养一夜后，通过"闻"其释放的挥发性代谢物实现菌种识别。该技术利用高灵敏度电子鼻芯片检测细菌特征性挥发物谱，无需传统的生化鉴定流程即可快速区分不同菌种。该方法在临床微生物快速诊断、食品安全检测和环境监测等领域具有重要应用潜力。

entries.t: 大型强子对撞机关闭演变成高光度大型强子对撞机
entries.c: 通用技术/检测和表征/先进科学仪器
entries.as: 全球最大的粒子对撞机大型强子对撞机（LHC）计划于今日关闭，开始为期四年以上的重大升级改造，耗资约12亿瑞士法郎（15亿美元）。升级后将成为高亮度LHC，旨在探索暗物质等宇宙最大谜团。该27公里长的质子对撞隧道位于瑞法边境地下100米处，是物理学研究的核心装置。
entries.b:
The world’s biggest particle smasher, the Large Hadron Collider, is scheduled for a shutdown today as it prepares for a major renovation that will allow it to look at the greatest mysteries of our universe – dark matter. The upgrade, scheduled to take over four years, is expected to cost 1.2 billion Swiss francs (US$1.5 billion).
The 17-mile (27 km) long proton-smashing tunnel, running 300 feet (100 m) below the ground near the Swiss-French border, is at the heart of the physics research conducted by the European Organization for Nuclear Research (CERN). In 2012, the laboratory found the Higgs boson, or the God particle, which helped scientists understand how particles acquire mass.
The discovery led to the 2013 Nobel Prize in Physics, and now scientists want to use the facility to understand dark matter and search for other dimensions. To do so, the facility requires a major upgrade in which all components in a 0.75-mile (1.2 km) section of the tunnel must be replaced, prompting a complete shutdown of the facility.
It is well accepted in the scientific community that ordinary matter that makes up the Sun, stars, planets and everything on them accounts for just five percent of the universe. The rest consists of components that we cannot directly observe or detect.
The invisible part is estimated to be made up of dark matter (27 percent) and dark energy (68 percent). Understanding dark matter and dark energy can give scientists major clues on how the universe evolved after the Big Bang.
A crucial part of the plan is understanding how the God particle works, which means the
will need to produce more of them in the future. According to CERN, the LHC has produced 55 million Higgs bosons since it began operations in 2008. Post the upgrade, the High Luminosity LHC (HL-HLC) will produce 380 million of them.

To produce a large number of Higgs bosons, researchers need to produce a larger
number of collisions
in the LHC. This will happen thanks to new superconducting magnets that will further concentrate the particle beams in the
. Once operational, the HL-LHC will see 140-200 collisions each time two packets of particles meet inside the tunnel. Currently, the number is only 60.
CERN scientists expect to collect 100 times more data from these collisions. However, in reality, the number of collisions is expected to be on the order of several billion per second and will produce so much data that scientists won’t even be able to store it.
Instead, they will deploy artificial intelligence (AI) that will be trained to identify promising events in real time and capture only that information. The upgrade is estimated to cost 1.2 billion Swiss francs ($1.5 billion), to be covered by CERN’s membership fees and donations from countries such as the US, Canada, Japan, and China.
In addition to more data, scientists are hopeful that the HL-LHC, when ready in 2030, will be able to produce two Higgs bosons simultaneously and even observe them interacting.
When the LHC shuts down today, it also opens up a new future of possibilities that it can explore in its new form.

entries.t: 曾破产的“铱星计划”被80亿美元盘下，买家要拿它跟Starlink抢生意
entries.c: 通用技术/通信和运输/航天
